_comment: The politics engine (M6): history at world creation and the world moving on while you play. rates are chances per year (scaled to the time step). lifespan multiplies ages by race (a dwarf of 140 is like a human of 40). reign: years a ruler usually lasts [min, max] by race. text: the words for each kind of event, used in the chronicle and in news ({slots} filled by code). dragons, artifacts and legends furnish the deep past.

war_reasons.trade: the trade roads and their tolls

old: in their sleep, full of years
murder: at the hands of their own guards
accident: in a fall from a horse
drowned crossing a river in flood
when a tower stair gave way

signs: The trees here stand burned and branchless, in a swathe a mile wide.
There are bones in the grass: cattle, and not only cattle.
Nothing sings here. The quiet has weight to it.
The rock is glazed black in places, as if a furnace had breathed on it.
A dead sheep lies half-eaten and untouched by crows, who know better.

fates: was buried with its last bearer in {site}
was carried into {site} and never came out
was stolen, and no one knows where it went
is said to lie somewhere in {site}

deeds: held the bridge at {place} alone against a warband
led the survivors of {place} through the winter
rode into {site} and did not return
walked out of the plague year alive and healed the sick
betrayed {faction} and was cursed for it
was the last of their line

crisis: {old} died {cause}, leaving no heir. {new} of {house} took the {seat}, and not everyone agreed.
When {old} died {cause} without an heir, {new} of {house} seized the {seat}.
battle: {loser} lost a battle to {winner} near {place}, and left many dead.
taken: {place} fell to {attacker} after a long siege.
sacked: {place} was put to the sword by {attacker}.
freedom: {liege} could not bring {rebel} to heel, and let them go.
crushed: The rebellion of {rebel} ended in blood.
famine: Famine in the lands of {faction}: the harvest failed.
A hungry year in {faction}'s lands, and bread dear everywhere.
raid: {tribe} came down on {place} in the night.
cult: Whispers began of a cult of {god} near {place}.
People went missing near {place}; some said a cult of {god} was to blame.
cult_purged: {church} rooted out a hidden cell of {cult} in {place}.
The faithful burned the secret shrine of {cult} near {place}.
cult_incident: Graves opened in the night near {place}.
Strange lights and missing folk near {place}.
A priest was found dead in {place}, and no one will say how.
gang_new: {gang} began to prey on the roads near {place}.
A new band of outlaws, {gang}, haunts the country near {place}.
gang_destroyed: {gang} were hunted down by the men of {lord}.
dragon: {dragon} came out of the mountains and burned {place}.
dragon_tribute: {dragon} came to {place}. They drove out cattle and set out silver, and were spared.
{place} pays tribute to {dragon} now: beasts, gold, and once a year something worse.
dragon_slain: {dragon} was killed by {legend}, at a price.
dragon_sleeps: {dragon} went back to its lair and has not been seen since.
No one has seen {dragon} for many years. Some say it only sleeps.
founded: Settlers raised the first houses of {place}.
ruin: {place} fell to {cause} and was never rebuilt.
marriage: {a} and {b} were joined by a marriage.
treaty: {a} and {b} swore a treaty of friendship.

notices: Wanted: a strong back at the smithy. Pay by the day.
Lost: a grey nanny goat, answers to nothing. Reward.
Rooms to let, clean straw, no fleas (or not many). Ask at the inn.
The ferryman will not cross after dark. Do not ask him.
Found: one boot. Owner may have it back for a kind word.
Masses said for the dead of the last winter, every seventh day.
A reward to whoever finds who has been taking the chickens.
Do not drink from the east well. The priest says it is bad.
Carters wanted for the road south. Must bring their own axe.
The widow of {place}'s last tanner sells his tools. Cheap.
ruin_causes: a curse, or so they say
